text:
Estimates assume about 30–40 g of cornflakes, roughly 200 ml of whole milk and a cappuccino of about 250 ml.

- Cornflakes, about 35 g: 130 kcal, 2.5 g protein, 30 g carbs, 0.3 g fat.
- Milk, about 200 ml whole: 130 kcal, 6.6 g protein, 9.6 g carbs, 7 g fat.
- Cappuccino, about 250 ml: 110 kcal, 6 g protein, 9 g carbs, 5.5 g fat.

That gives about 370 kcal served. Assuming roughly 20 kcal is left over, about 350 kcal is eaten, with protein about 14 g, carbs about 47 g and fat about 12 g.
